title: Ellipse 12 x 6 extruded 10, Draft of its free-form wall 5 degrees about XY (FreeCAD's own Draft cannot tilt such a face)

expect.note: Each height z is the ellipse offset inward by z tan5 (the drafted wall); a smooth closed curve offset by d has area A0 - P d + pi d^2 (Steiner), so V = A0 H - P tan5 H^2/2 + pi tan5^2 H^3/3, A0 = pi 12 6, P = the ellipse's perimeter 58.130689323 (its arc-length integral). OpenCASCADE's volume of the drafted B-spline wall is ~0.5 % off: measured on a mesh.
